That is clear coordination. However, the coordination appears to be in direct service of the stated system objective (maximize completed tasks, avoid duplicates, minimize cost) rather than secretive or rule-breaking behavior against an external party. So this is consistent with collusive-style coordination, but not strong evidence of improper collusion beyond normal cooperative task allocation.
